opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: up to £200 (Scheme A); up to £500 (Scheme B); up to £750 for Adelphi co‑sponsored award; up to £300 (Scheme C)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scheme A: undergraduate, MSc and PhD students and post‑doctoral members within six years of PhD viva. Schemes B & C: PhD students and post‑doctoral members within six years of PhD viva. Applicants must be UK‑based members (or non‑UK members attending UK‑based conferences).
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance at genetics‑related conferences (Society meetings, other meetings, or virtual conferences) by providing travel, accommodation and registration funding.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members who are studying or working in the UK, or whose course is in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others need at least one year of membership.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to enable members to attend short formal training courses or collaborative visits to learn specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members who are studying or working in the UK, or intend to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students need a supervisor who is also a Society member.
opportunities.summary: Supports field‑based genetic research projects by covering travel, accommodation, subsistence, consumables and limited equipment costs.

opportunities.title: One‑off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: few hundred pounds up to several thousand pounds (typical major sponsorship £1,000–£2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Genetics Society proposing a genetics‑themed meeting (UK‑based or with strong UK links).
opportunities.summary: Provides sponsorship for stand‑alone genetics meetings not organised directly by the Society, covering venue, travel, accommodation and a Carer’s Award.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities (in‑person or virtual) related to genetics, covering travel and material costs.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics research communities wishing to run a regular series of meetings; applications submitted by prospective group leaders.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £2,000 annually to support regular meetings of a new or existing Special Interest Group centred on a genetics theme.
